_note: Profile overlay of the mainnet TEST deployment (throwaway program ids and a throwaway pump.fun quote coin shown as UNITS; closed when the test ends). Public values only. It is the deployment config/profile.json selects today (`mainnet_deployment`: "test"), so the repository's default network, mainnet, resolves to it with no environment variable. The official mainnet ids are in config/profile.json `profiles.mainnet` and are not deployed yet; setting `mainnet_deployment` to "official" there stops this overlay from being applied.
